evidence.description: Completed Supabase schema validation against application requirements

data.validation_result: Schema has strong foundation but requires targeted adjustments
key_findings: Most core tables exist: programs (Shows), episodes, participants (Guests), organizations
AI support already built-in: ai_generations and audit_log tables present
Main issues: nullability mismatches, type inconsistencies, missing enum validation
Recommendations: Make required fields NOT NULL, fix type inconsistencies, add enum constraints

evidence.description: Updated TypeScript types based on real Supabase schema

key_improvements: Schema accuracy: Types now precisely reflect the validated Supabase schema
Nullability safety: Properly distinguishes between required and optional fields
JSON handling: Preserves JSON-typed fields for complex structures
Relationship preservation: Maintains foreign key relationships for proper joins
Fixed previousEpisodes type: Changed from string[] to number | null to match schema
next_steps: Implement Supabase persistence layer replacing JSON local storage

evidence.description: Completed RLS authorization validation with 28 comprehensive tests against real Supabase database

key_validations: Users can only see their own organizations (Test Org vs Other Org isolation)
Programs access restricted to user's organization (owner/viewer can read, only owner can write)
Episodes access controlled via program hierarchy (isolation enforced)
Participants access controlled via program hierarchy (isolation enforced)
Episode_participants junction access follows episode/program ownership
Program INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE restricted to owner/admin roles
Organization UPDATE restricted to owner/admin roles
Organization members management restricted to owner/admin roles
Service role bypasses all RLS policies (server-side operations)
rls_fixes_applied: Granted USAGE on tm_private schema to authenticated role
Granted EXECUTE on tm_private.is_org_member/is_org_role to authenticated role
Granted SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on core tables to authenticated role
Split programs tm_org_access policy into SELECT (all members) and INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE (owner/admin only)
